what_happened: Annual craft award founded by Jonathan Anderson. The 2017 exhibition showed 26 nominees and drew a fashion and art crowd.
270 sqm over two floors that combine a store and an art gallery with rotating exhibits, such as a painting by Zilia Sanchez, basketry by Joe Hogan and a tea set by Takuro Kuwata.
results_and_next_move: Brand sales rose 38% in 2021 to EUR 456 million (not specific to this store).
